Occurrences.Kwic: 江西十八灘。照出芙蓉城下月，金波影裏麥秋寒。示禪人示禪人鐵石身心來問道，慣調金鏃若為醻？棒頭喝下隨流入，靠倒溈山水牯牛。一句全提絕類倫，萬機不到始通津。道人別有遮天眼，四海無家總是親。顧鑑全抽徹底參，新豐三頓實難甘。到頭恩怨無餘地，贏得兒孫轉放憨。六塵不惡機難測，三昧無聲妙莫窮。脫體頓拋忘朕跡，瞎驢何處覓行蹤。懸崖捉拍舞三臺，死虎驚忙眼豁開，聖地不生凡草木，果然親見瞎堂

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Look-and-discern is the paired action named in Chan classifications as Yunmen's house procedure and later invoked, exceeded, or criticized in hall discourse.
EvidenceBody: A lineage classification pairs Linji with exchanging guest and host and Shaoyang—Yunmen—with fully surpassing look-and-discern. The Human and Celestial Eyes describes the procedure as looking at an arriving monk, saying 'discern,' and sometimes saying 'yi.'

A preface applies the pair to Juelang Daosheng's teaching-seat movement; Dagui Foxing Fatai says an action is not look-and-discern, and later discourse asks what remains when the procedure is not yet understood. The exact pair therefore names a transmitted procedure, not an incidental act of checking a mirror.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: Two ordinary action graphs are lexicalized as a named Yunmen house procedure and become an object of later appraisal.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: A personal name containing 鑑 and ordinary prose about looking back are excluded; only cases deploying the established pair are retained.

ComparedThings: its attested grammatical and rhetorical deployments
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Classification, procedural definition, enactment, and criticism point to the same Yunmen house procedure.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Roman-free probes join Yunmen with the paired actions so readers do not retrieve personal names containing 鑑.

ModifierControls.Finding: The headword is a paired procedure-name rather than a modifier construction.

FamilyControls.Finding: A neighboring Yunmen procedure described separately in Human and Celestial Eyes.
Single-graph personal names and ordinary discerning do not attest this paired headword's procedure.
